subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “It only made big tasks feel less scary.”?
options: Repairing something can save money and reduce waste, but it can also open a small door into how things work.
A minute cannot finish everything, but it can open the door.
They simply open the door and take what they need.
Entertainment can open the door to history, but careful reading must walk through it.
